platforms.name: 95bFM Auckland Lossless Stream-and-Download Airplay Submission Route
platforms.country: New Zealand / Auckland / independent alternative student radio with electronic, dub, reggae, hip-hop, house, jungle, global-beat and experimental programming
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee, account, login or mandatory payment is stated for the official music-submissions email route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: 95bFM's current official Submit Music page instructs artists to use the station's dedicated music-submissions email link and include both a streaming link and a download link to a lossless WAV or FLAC file. The stream and download must not require an account, password or platform login, and Spotify is explicitly unsuitable. The destination address is protected by Cloudflare on the official pages and was not decoded, guessed or stored. A human must open the authorized email link, confirm the current destination and international eligibility, choose a suitable MarcsMusic track, ensure the stream and non-expiring lossless download are accessible without authentication, provide artist name, song title, origin and release date, verify rights, content labels and current AI-origin policy, and send manually. Tracks older than one month remain submittable but are no longer eligible for high-rotation A/B playlisting.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-14 from 95bFM's official homepage, Submit Music page, Staff Directory and current Shows page. The homepage links directly to the submission instructions and displayed live programming plus a 31 July 2026 station event. The submission page requires a stream plus a lossless download, rejects account-gated or password-protected delivery and names WAV and FLAC as supported formats. It requests artist and song names, origin and release timing, while discouraging long bios. The current schedule includes electronic works, dub and reggae, alternative hip-hop, house, jungle, experimental and globally sourced programming, creating a plausible fit for selected MarcsMusic releases. The Staff Directory repeats a dedicated Music Submissions contact but protects the email through Cloudflare; it was not decoded or treated as plaintext. A general first-party contact form was observed but not queued because the station provides a purpose-specific submission route. Verification was limited to official publication, first-party source continuity, stated purpose and current site activity; no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.

platforms.name: RadioActive.FM Wellington Music Submission Email and Physical Delivery Route
platforms.country: New Zealand / Wellington / independent alternative radio with electronic, guest-mix, dance, indie, heavy and specialist programming
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee, account, login or mandatory payment is stated for the official music-submissions email or postal route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: RadioActive.FM's official Contact page publishes music@radioactive.fm specifically for Music Submissions and also authorizes posting music to the station. The page does not state accepted codecs, bitrate, attachment versus download-link rules, release-age limits, metadata, rights language, AI-origin policy, international eligibility or response expectations. A human must reconfirm the current rules, select a genre-appropriate MarcsMusic release, confirm whether email delivery should use a stream, lossless download or another method, avoid unsolicited attachments unless explicitly permitted, verify rights and content labels, and send manually. Any physical package also requires human preparation and postage.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-14 from RadioActive.FM's official homepage, Contact page and current programme pages. The Contact page explicitly labels music@radioactive.fm as Music Submissions and provides an authorized postal alternative. The address has valid syntax, matches the first-party domain and is separated from general enquiries, bookings, advertising and staff mailboxes. Current activity was confirmed by official items dated 13 July 2026, 8 July 2026 and 2 July 2026, a populated weekly schedule and active live-listening routes. Programming includes electronic guest mixes and Te Ao Tech electronica alongside indie, alternative, heavy and other specialist shows. The public submission instructions do not provide technical delivery requirements or explicit international eligibility, so the route remains manual. Email verification was limited to official publication, syntax, first-party domain alignment, cross-page station context and stated business purpose; no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
